metadata.title: Retro Group Portrait with Stylized Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for multi-person group portraits featuring a tiered arrangement against a natural sky backdrop with high-contrast stylized display typography at the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tiered group portrait of seven men in 1970s attire, positioned against a soft, cloudy blue sky. The composition is anchored by a central figure in a white vest, with others arranged in two rows. The top edge features stylized, high-contrast sans-serif typography with a distinct horizontal emphasis.
coreVisualRelationships: Tiered human subjects against a natural sky background
High-contrast white clothing against blue and grey sky tones
Top-aligned typography framing the upper composition
Symmetrical balance with a central visual anchor
coreInvariants: Stylized display typography at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Seven subjects arranged in two rows (four in back, three in front), filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the back row wearing a white vest and dark shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central anchor outward to the flanking subjects, then upward to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is primarily negative space occupied by the sky and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and hair colors
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) clothing against a medium-value, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly saturated modern colors

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-like gaps or high-contrast internal negative space
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a 'tubular' or 'pill-shaped' internal structure
Horizontal bars are emphasized over vertical stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used for all text elements to maintain retro-futuristic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, 70s tech aesthetic.
Provides the necessary square-round geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of seven men in 1970s fashion (white suits, vests, patterned shirts) arranged in two rows against a soft blue and white cloudy sky. Leave the top 20% of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering at the top left and top right corners using an ultra-expanded, rounded geometric sans-serif style in dark grey.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects arranged in a tiered group formation?
Is the background a soft, cloudy sky?
Is the clothing primarily white or light-colored?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 70s era-appropriate hair and fashion
Ensure text does not overlap subject heads
Verify the horizontal stretch of the typography
Confirm the tiered row arrangement of the group
Ensure the sky background is soft and not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Tiered group portrait + 70s fashion + cloudy sky backdrop + [Top-aligned ultra-expanded geometric sans-serif typography]
